subject: POC prompt set & eval plan — next steps / ACME Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 18:12:00 +0000
Subject: POC: Prompt set & eval plan — next steps / ACME Health

Hi Alex / Jamie —

Thanks again for the call today — appreciate the walkthrough of ACME's primary evaluation goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC scoped and scheduled: 

Call recap / success criteria (as we understand it):
- Latency: < 500ms 95th for the user-facing assistant flows.
- Accuracy: pass-rate >= 85% on the medical triage prompts you shared as "must-pass" cases.
- Safety/incorrect-answer reduction: reduce hallucinations on drug/diagnosis prompts by 50% vs baseline.
- Cost: target token cost <= $0.004 per output token for pre-prod workload (we'll refine after seeing real logs).

POC evaluation plan (proposed):
1) You provide a prompt set + sample logs (anonymized) — we'll port into our eval harness.
2) Redwood runs three model variants (baseline -> quantized -> L2) against the prompt set and returns a per-prompt rubric and aggregated metrics.
3) Joint review session to validate the rubric on 20 representative prompts.
4) Roll-forward to a week-long pilot with live traffic routing and detailed cost/latency dashboards.

Ownership / timelines (proposed):
- ACME to provide: initial prompt set (CSV) + 24-48 hours worth of anonymized logs or representative examples — target by Fri 2026-03-27.
- Redwood (Marissa / Priya): ingest prompts, produce eval template and run on three variants by Wed 2026-04-01.
- CS (Stephanie): coordinate secure upload and ensure data handling meets your controls.

Action items / asks (for Alex / Jamie):
- Please upload the prompt CSV and one sample logs file to the secure folder we created (link below). If you can't use the Drive link, we can provide an SFTP token.
- Mark or highlight the ~20 "must-pass" prompts that reflect critical business flows so we can seed the rubric.

Upload link (secure): https://secure-upload.redwood.com/acme-health/poctemp
Shared drive (read-only for Redwood): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEfghiJKLMnoPqRstUV
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/458

I'll follow up internally to assign the eval owner — Priya and I will own the prompt/rubric work; Stephanie will own the secure transfer and compliance checks.

Thanks — look forward to the files.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment stubs: poc_eval_template.xlsx (blank template), prompt_example_format.csv (sample)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 20:31:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC: Prompt set & eval plan — next steps / ACME Health

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and plan. That matches how we saw the call. We'll do the following:
- I'll export the last 48 hours of anonymized assistant logs and a CSV of ~150 prompts (mix of triage, scheduling, insurance questions).
- I'll flag 25 "must-pass" prompts for the rubric.
- We prefer SFTP for security — can you confirm SFTP credentials or the alternative is your secure-upload endpoint.

Target: I'll aim to have the files uploaded by EOD Fri (2026-03-27). If we hit a delay, I'll let you know by Thursday.

One quick clarification on success criteria: the 85% pass-rate — is that strict across all prompt types or only clinical triage prompts? We expect scheduling/insurance to be easier and want to make sure the rubric weights reflect that.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Product, Conversational AI | ACME Health
alex.johnson@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: FW: POC: Prompt set & eval plan — next steps / ACME Health

Team — forwarding ACME's confirmation. Key asks for us:

1) Eval rubric owner: Priya, please draft the per-prompt rubric (binary pass + severity tags + confidence ranges) and the aggregation rules. Use the attached poc_eval_template.xlsx. Target: initial draft by Mon 2026-03-30.

2) Model variants & compute: Vivek / Rishi, we should pin three variants for the POC: current open baseline (v1), a quantized fp16 variant (v1-q8), and a lower-cost 8-bit variant (v1-q8-accel). Estimate runtime costs and token throughput for a 1k-req/day pilot and confirm we can meet the 500ms 95th SLO in our hosted config. Please validate by Fri 2026-03-27 so we can commit timelines.

3) Security / transfer: Stephanie, please provide SFTP credentials or confirm secure-upload token and any required paperwork ACME needs to sign (BSA/NDA already in place). Also confirm data retention policy for the sample logs.

4) Customer communications: I'll be the primary point of contact; Stephanie will coordinate transfer. Priya will lead rubric and evaluation results.

Attach: poc_eval_template.xlsx (template for rubric)

If you see any blockers, call out ASAP.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC: Prompt set & eval plan — next steps / ACME Health

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the note. We can accept either SFTP or our secure-upload endpoint. For SFTP:
- Host: sftp.redwood-secure.com
- User: acme_poc_upload
- I'll send the one-time password via a separate encrypted email/SMS once you confirm the upload window.

Secure-upload endpoint details: https://secure-upload.redwood.com/acme-health/poctemp — we have enterprise-grade TLS + at-rest encryption. Retention for samples: we keep samples used for eval for 90 days by default; we can adjust this via contract if you need deletion sooner.

Required paperwork: since we already have an NDA and BAA in place, there is no additional paperwork for sample uploads. If you prefer a signed data handling addendum (DHA), we can route that through Legal — let me know.

Attachments: sample manifest template (acme_system_logs_sample.txt)

Stephanie Nguyen
